project.name: TH Marble website
project.summary: TH Marble & Granite has supplied and exported Egyptian marble and granite since 1998, with projects across Africa, Asia and Europe. Most new enquiries come by phone and WhatsApp, and international buyers have no place online to browse the stone range or see finished work. The company needs a website that shows its collection, proves its track record and turns visits into quote requests.
goals: Show the full marble and granite collection with a page for every stone
Turn visitors into quote requests through a form and one-tap WhatsApp
Reach export buyers with English, French and Spanish versions
inScope: Home page with intro video, collection preview and project highlights
Marble and granite pages with a section for each of the 14 stones
Projects gallery, About page and Contact page with a quote form
Mobile layout, basic SEO, and an admin panel to edit content
outOfScope: Photography (stone photos supplied by the client)
Domain, hosting and third-party subscription fees
Translation of content (translated text supplied by the client)
Ongoing maintenance after the support period

kickoff.audience: Contractors, developers and homeowners in Egypt, plus importers in Africa, Asia and Europe. They want to compare stones, see finished projects and ask for a price, mostly from a phone.
metrics: All 14 stones have a page with photos, finishes and a quote button
